const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const file = path.join(process.cwd(), 'src', 'extension.ts');

const replacement = [
  'type Token =',
  '    | { t: "{" | "}"; idx?: number }',
  '    | { t: "str"; v: string; idx?: number };',
  '',
  'function tokenizeKVWithStripped(input: string): { tokens: Token[]; stripped: string } {',
  '    const s = stripComments(input);',
  '    const tokens: Token[] = [];',
  '    let i = 0;',

  '    const isWS = (c: string) => c === " " || c === "\\t" || c === "\\r" || c === "\\n";',

  '        const c = s[i];',
  '',
  '        if (isWS(c)) { i++; continue; }',
  '        if (c === "{" || c === "}") { tokens.push({ t: c, idx: i }); i++; continue; }',
  '',
  '        if (c === "\\"") {',
  '            const start = i;',
  '            i++; // skip opening "',
  '            let out = "";',

  '                    i++; continue;',
  '                }',
  '                if (ch === "\\"") { i++; break; }',
  '                out += ch;',
  '                i++;',
  '            }',
